partitions.note: Prebaked from the planning analysis at 440d9b5; no separate recon pass. Excludes every path owned by parquet_duckdb_pivot_20260823 slices d0-d5. lane_registry.py, interface/cli/data.py, alembic/versions/ and the cron Dockerfile are shared registries with one named owner each: later slices append and must be sequenced, never run concurrently on those files. Re-verify `owns` with a real grep once HEAD moves. RE-VERIFIED at 80ac72a (RUNBOOK 0.42.15): every `owns` path grepped against HEAD -- no drift, every `future` path genuinely absent and every existing one present. s2/s3/s4 overlap on pipeline/direct/ and tests/direct/ (directory owner vs files inside it) but are SEQUENCED by depends_on and all sit in lane A, so that is ordering, not contention. The one real collision is external: pivot d5 creates pipeline/lanes/soil_field.py inside s5's directory -- d5 moves to lane A and lands first. s2a replaced the retired flat CLI with the four-group interface/cli package and retained interface/cli/data.py as the s2b registration point.

slices.task: P0 bridge: restore cronSchedule so a writer runs on a clock again; correct the Dockerfile header (it still claims the schedule was removed on purpose and that continuous-warehouse-loop.sh replaces it); verify the drain stays down.
slices.note: Forward cron configuration is present on integrated main. Scheduled cadence and ledger advancement still require production observation before this bridge can authorize retirement.

slices.task: P1 alembic greenfield baseline: one revision reflecting production as-is (no timescaledb, tracking.positions plain), archive the historical revisions, re-point every migration-contract test, move the readiness pin, stamp production. Fallback to a forward migration if the agri-schema pg_dump diff is non-empty.
slices.note: Baseline and forward migration contracts through 20260827_0027 are integrated. Do not claim production stamp/parity from code alone; verify /ready and the live migration head during the cutover gate.

slices.task: P2 direct-writer foundation, folded with the CLI split (owner decision 2026-08-25). Two sequenced sub-slices share interface/cli/data.py: s2a replaces the retired flat CLI with interface/cli/ groups forecast|ml|data|ops and hard-cuts the binary to agri-service with no aliases; s2b adds the direct-writer protocol, parity harness, parquet-ingest verb and lane-to-writer registry plus wave 1 sensors and weather-observations.
slices.note: s2a extracted the framework-free Parquet core and completed the CLI split. The unfinished s2b direct-writer registry and forward execution scope is delegated to gapless_parquet_publication_20260901. This track retains P5/P6 retirement authority and may not execute the delegated writer work in parallel.

slices.task: P3 wave 2 direct writers: drought, water-gauges, fire-perimeters, burn-severity, watersheds, evacuation-zones, and the soil-survey decision; replace the three Postgres-backed static-lookup watermark resolvers with an upstream vintage or record that a lane keeps its Postgres watermark.
slices.note: Forward-writer implementation and activation delegated to gapless_parquet_publication_20260901. Historical ownership is retained here only as provenance for the eventual P5 retirement review.

slices.task: P4 wave 3 direct writers for the governance-heavy lanes: signal (governed contract table + release dedup + centroid), vegetation (eight lineage refs), fire-detections (cell-day aggregate + FIRMS cap surfaced).
slices.note: Forward-writer implementation and activation delegated to gapless_parquet_publication_20260901. Historical ownership is retained here only as provenance for the eventual P5 retirement review.

slices.task: P5 per-lane Postgres retirement: delete each verified lane's ingest producer and runner registration, switch the cron entrypoint to parquet-ingest for verified lanes, drop the lane tables as migrations on the s1 baseline. Exporter deletion waits on pivot d1.
slices.note: Does NOT own pipeline/lanes/soil_field.py -- pivot d5 creates it and must land first (RUNBOOK 0.42.15). Retire a lane's producer only after that lane's parity passes; soil-field has no Postgres producer to retire.

slices.task: P6 final shrink: drop the signal unique CONSTRAINT (10.78 GB), the remaining signal indexes, then agri.signal_observation; then the geo.features/geo.geometry data-plane rows for retired lanes via a drizzle migration. Gated on pivot d3 and d4.

Repoint the agent/MCP tool plane off Postgres SQL onto the shared Parquet core. NINE of the twelve statements in sql/agent/ read a matview or view over a moving plane, and FOUR read geo.mv_signal_cell_daily, which was DROPPED 2026-08-18 -- those tools have been returning a typed pre_aggregated_plane_unbuilt refusal for a week. Re-author them against the core rather than translating the SQL, and FIX THE REFUSAL WORDING: it claims the relation 'exists in the schema but has never been refreshed', which is now false and sends the next reader chasing a refresh that cannot happen. Carry the rationale, not the SQL -- nearest_signal_cells.sql's LEFT-JOIN-not-INNER argument and its explicit-zero coalesce are the asset; the query is dead.
slices.note: Uncovered by either partition set before 2026-08-25 -- nothing owned sql/agent/ or agent/tools.py. Depends on s2 because it consumes the core s2a extracts. RUNBOOK 0.42.22.
